findings.title: CVE-2026-101891 WatchGuard AP Improper Access Control in API Service Allows Unauthenticated Access
findings.summary_md: Vendor advisory published 2026-09-28 for improper access control (CWE-284, CWE-923) in an internal API service of WatchGuard AP, letting an unauthenticated attacker with network access to the AP obtain a valid API session. Scored 9.3 on CVSS v4.0, affecting AP firmware 1.0 up to but not including 3.4.8, fixed in 3.4.8. WatchGuard credits discovery to internal research and states it is not aware of any exploitation in the wild.

findings.title: CVE-2026-86102 WatchGuard AP Command Injection in Internal Management API Allows Command Execution
findings.summary_md: Vendor advisory published 2026-09-28 for OS command injection (CWE-78) with incorrect authorization (CWE-863) in the WatchGuard AP internal management API service, allowing an attacker with network access to the AP to execute arbitrary shell commands on the underlying operating system without authentication. Scored 9.3 on CVSS v4.0, affecting firmware 1.0 up to but not including 3.4.8, fixed in 3.4.8. Credited to researcher Yukusawa, with no exploitation known to WatchGuard.

findings.title: CVE-2026-87969 WatchGuard AP Authenticated Command Injection in Diagnostic CLI
findings.summary_md: Vendor advisory published 2026-09-28 for authenticated OS command injection (CWE-78) in the WatchGuard AP diagnostic CLI, letting an authenticated administrator execute arbitrary operating system commands via crafted input. Scored 8.6 on CVSS v4.0 with high privileges required, affecting firmware 1.0 up to but not including 3.4.8, fixed in 3.4.8. Credited to Carlos Garrido of Pentraze Cybersecurity, with no exploitation known to WatchGuard.
